import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis: Demographics & Spending Patterns', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Calculate age and total spending
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education Level
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
education_order = ['Basic', '2n Cycle', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD']
present_education = [e for e in education_order if e in df['Education'].unique()]
for edu in present_education:
    subset = df[df['Education'] == edu]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Income'], subset['Total_Spending'], alpha=0.5, label=edu, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Annual Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Spending by Product Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
spending_means = [df[cat].mean() for cat in spending_categories]
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(spending_categories))
bars = ax2.bar(category_labels, spending_means, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
            f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Age Distribution by Marital Status
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
marital_order = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts().index[:5]
data_to_plot = [df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]['Age'].dropna() for status in marital_order]
bp = ax3.boxplot(data_to_plot, labels=marital_order, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], sns.color_palette('Set2', len(marital_order))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')
plt.setp(ax3.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=15, ha='right')

# 4. Purchase Channel Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
channel_totals = [df[ch].sum() for ch in channels]
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(channels))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(channel_totals, labels=channel_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_pie, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Purchases by Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
